The '''''Executioner''''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War|renewed conflict]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was sent to assist the Imperial [[Invasion of Manaan|operation]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="Retaliation" />
